dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Clearly visible single horizontal white band on the greater coverts with high grayscale contrast and moderate thickness.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High visual prominence with sharp boundary contrast; pale edges on folded secondaries and primaries form distinct converging lines.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct, bright white rectangular patch is visible on the posterior neck/nape region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, linear boundary separates the dark crown from the uniform greenish-grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct white auricular (cheek) patch and a smaller white patch on the hindneck.
